objective: Review the importable native parser-to-sidecar adapter fixture implementation and accept only the non-executing parser-owned-field handoff, without claiming sidecar runtime handoff, RTL simulation, coverage-output equivalence, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing.

review_decision.reason: The helper is a small importable adapter authority rather than a sidecar stage-plan result. It copies parser-owned Verilator inputs, keeps filelists unexpanded, exposes correctness_policy_ref only as a later sidecar policy reference, records unresolved sidecar responsibilities, rejects parser values that already contain resolved sidecar-owned outputs, and rejects parser-supplied correctness policy alternatives.
review_decision.weakest_point: This still stops before real native Verilator sidecar execution. The adapter payload is not yet resolved into the existing sidecar stage plan, does not select coverage-output targets or host-probe metadata, does not materialize state/report paths, does not run RTL simulation or compare, and does not prove timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing.
accepted_because: the adapter payload field set is explicit and excludes resolved sidecar-owned state files, reports, compare labels, coverage targets, manifest refs, host-probe metadata, and emitted Verilator commands

ordinary Verilator args, mdir, top module, source files, filelists, defines, include dirs, and warning flags are preserved from parser-stub values without source closure expansion or target registry lookup
correctness_policy_ref is named as a reference-only field with adapter_default_reference_only_not_parser_populated_compare_evidence status and is fixed to coverage_output_equivalence
the helper rejects parser values that already include sidecar-owned resolved outputs, so the parser/adapter boundary does not silently bless downstream artifacts
the fixture adds no public CLI, Verilator source-tree dependency, runtime or ABI change, execution path, measurement path, or new workload

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_boundary_gate
must_define: how the accepted adapter payload will be resolved into the existing sidecar stage-plan surface without making the native parser infer source closure, coverage targets, host-probe metadata, state paths, report paths, or compare labels
which explicit metadata inputs are required before adapter payload can call or mirror the existing sidecar planning helpers
which sidecar-owned fields may be resolved by the plan-resolution layer and which remain forbidden in parser-owned values
how correctness_policy_ref maps to the later coverage_output_equivalence compare policy without treating parser handoff as compare evidence
how the boundary stays non-executing before any RTL simulation, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary RTL/filelist, or automatic allocation claim
must_not_claim: coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a new public CLI or workflow
not new timing or speedup evidence
not parser inference of coverage manifests, host-probe metadata, source closure, state paths, or report paths
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
